asked.item: exact number of videos per day YouTube allows for an unverified channel
error "The user has exceeded the number of videos they may upload" for a new, unverified channel

verdict.reason: No sentence gives YouTube's exact daily upload number for unverified channels; the help pages only say such limits exist, may change, and should be checked on YouTube's official page, and the Blotato per-channel limits (10 or 25) are a different limit.
